title: Software Engineering Intern - Spring 2027
text:
Pipal Systems is hiring interns for a six-month spring internship in Hyderabad.

Eligibility
- Final-year B.Tech/M.Tech students, 0-1 years of experience
- Strong data structures and algorithms
- Proficiency in C++ or Java
- Good understanding of operating systems, DBMS and computer networks
- OOP concepts

Bonus
- Basics of system design
- Comfort with Linux and the command line
